tools.name: check_reference_memo
tools.description: Pre-flight check for memoless transactions. Returns what reference would be extracted from the amount and whether it's available for registration.

tools.name: get_affiliate_earnings
tools.description: Returns affiliate earnings including fees collected by thorname.

tools.name: get_affiliate_history
tools.description: Returns historical affiliate swap data including volumes and thorname breakdown over time.

tools.name: get_affiliate_stats
tools.description: Returns affiliate statistics including volumes, counts, and fees by thorname.

tools.name: get_ban
tools.description: Returns the ban status for a node address. Shows if the node is banned, at what block height, and which nodes signed the ban. Bans are used to remove malicious or misbehaving nodes.

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: Returns verbose details of a THORChain block including header info, transactions, and block events. If no height is specified, returns the latest block. Shows block hash, chain ID, height, time, validator info, and all transactions with their results.

tools.name: get_bonds
tools.description: Returns bond details for an address including associated nodes and total bonded amount.

tools.name: get_churns
tools.description: Returns churn event history with dates and block heights.

tools.name: get_cometbft_block
tools.description: Returns block data at the specified height including header, transactions, and commit signatures. Provides canonical blockchain data.

tools.name: get_cometbft_block_results
tools.description: Returns the results of executing transactions in a block, including ABCI events and validator updates. Useful for inspecting transaction outcomes.

tools.name: get_cometbft_consensus_params
tools.description: Returns CometBFT consensus parameters (block size, evidence, validator params) at a height.

tools.name: get_cometbft_consensus_state
tools.description: Returns the current consensus round state including height/round/step, proposal block hash, and vote information. Useful for debugging consensus issues.

tools.name: get_cometbft_net_info
tools.description: Returns network information including listening status, connected peers, and peer details. Useful for monitoring P2P network health.

tools.name: get_cometbft_status
tools.description: Returns the CometBFT node status including node info, sync status, and validator information. Provides canonical consensus-level data about the blockchain.

tools.name: get_cometbft_tx
tools.description: Returns a transaction by its hash including tx result, height, and optional proof of inclusion. Provides canonical transaction data from the consensus layer.

tools.name: get_cometbft_validators
tools.description: Returns the validator set at the specified height including addresses, public keys, and voting power. This is canonical consensus data about who can produce blocks.

tools.name: get_constants
tools.description: Returns protocol constants including integer, boolean, and string configuration values that govern THORChain behavior.

tools.name: get_cosmos_account
tools.description: Returns account information for a THORChain address including account number, sequence (nonce), and public key if available.

tools.name: get_cosmos_balances
tools.description: Returns account balances for a THORChain address. Shows all coin denominations held by the account.

tools.name: get_cosmos_block
tools.description: Returns a block at the specified height from the Cosmos SDK blockchain including header, transactions, and commit data.

tools.name: get_cosmos_delegations
tools.description: Returns all delegations for a delegator address. Shows which validators the address has delegated to and the amounts.

tools.name: get_cosmos_latest_block
tools.description: Returns the latest block from the Cosmos SDK blockchain including header, transactions, and commit data.

tools.name: get_cosmos_node_info
tools.description: Returns Cosmos SDK node information including network, version, protocol versions, and application version. Uses the gRPC-gateway REST API for canonical data.

tools.name: get_cosmos_rewards
tools.description: Returns delegation rewards for a delegator address. Shows rewards from each validator and total accumulated rewards.

tools.name: get_cosmos_supply
tools.description: Returns the total token supply including all coin denominations. Shows the circulating supply of RUNE and other tokens.

tools.name: get_cosmos_syncing
tools.description: Returns whether the node is currently syncing with the blockchain. A syncing node may have stale data.

tools.name: get_cosmos_tx
tools.description: Returns a transaction by hash from the Cosmos SDK blockchain. Includes transaction body, auth info, and execution result.

tools.name: get_cosmos_validators
tools.description: Returns the list of staking validators. Includes operator address, status, tokens, delegator shares, commission rates, and description.

tools.name: get_depth_history
tools.description: Returns historical depth data for a pool including asset depth, RUNE depth, asset price, and liquidity units over time intervals.

tools.name: get_derived_pool
tools.description: Returns one derived (virtual) pool's depths and status.

tools.name: get_dynamic_l1_fees
tools.description: Returns per-THORName dynamic L1 minimum swap-fee floors (ADR-026). Each entry shows the enrolled THORName, trading pair, current dynamic fee floor in basis points, whitelist state (1=Active, 2=Monitor), last active epoch, and latest fee revenue in TOR.

tools.name: get_earnings_history
tools.description: Returns historical earnings data including liquidity fees, block rewards, and bonding/liquidity earnings over time intervals.

tools.name: get_holders
tools.description: Returns top RUNE holders with their balances.

tools.name: get_inbound_addresses
tools.description: Returns vault addresses for depositing assets into THORChain. Each chain has its own inbound address along with gas rates and halted status.

tools.name: get_invariant
tools.description: Runs a specific protocol invariant check and returns the result. Shows whether the invariant is broken and any informative messages about the check. Use this to verify protocol consistency and detect potential issues.

tools.name: get_keygen
tools.description: Returns keygen information for a specific block height and pubkey. Shows details of the key generation ceremony including the keygen block, member nodes, and signature. Use this to investigate vault creation events.

tools.name: get_keygen_metric
tools.description: Returns keygen timing metrics for a specific vault public key.

tools.name: get_keysign
tools.description: Returns keysign information for a specific block height. Shows transactions that were scheduled to be signed at that height, including outbound transaction details. Use this to investigate signing operations at a particular block.

tools.name: get_keysign_pubkey
tools.description: Returns keysign information for a specific block height and vault pubkey. Shows transactions signed by a particular vault at that height. Use this to investigate a specific vault's signing activity.

tools.name: get_known_pools
tools.description: Returns known pools with their status (available, staged, suspended).

tools.name: get_lastblock
tools.description: Returns the last observed and signed block heights for all chains. Useful for monitoring chain sync status and detecting chain halts.

tools.name: get_lastblock_chain
tools.description: Returns the last observed and signed block heights for a specific chain. Useful for monitoring a particular chain's sync status.

tools.name: get_limit_swaps
tools.description: Returns the limit swaps queue containing pending limit orders. Each entry includes swap details, ratio, age, and expiry information. Supports filtering by source/target asset, sender, and pagination. Limit orders only work when AdvSwapQueueEnabled is true.

tools.name: get_limit_swaps_summary
tools.description: Returns a summary of the limit swaps queue including total count, total USD value, breakdown by asset pair, oldest swap age, and average age. Useful for getting an overview of pending limit orders without retrieving all individual swaps.

tools.name: get_liquidity_history
tools.description: Returns historical liquidity change data including add/withdraw counts, volumes, and net liquidity over time intervals.

tools.name: get_lp_position
tools.description: Returns liquidity provider position information for a specific address in a pool. Includes units, pending asset/rune, and last add/withdraw heights.

tools.name: get_members
tools.description: Returns list of all liquidity provider addresses.

tools.name: get_midgard_balance
tools.description: Returns balance for an address from Midgard analytics.

tools.name: get_midgard_member
tools.description: Returns liquidity provider positions for an address including pool participation, units, and deposit/withdraw history.

tools.name: get_midgard_nodes
tools.description: Returns node information including addresses and public keys from Midgard analytics.

tools.name: get_midgard_stats
tools.description: Returns global network statistics including swap counts, volumes, liquidity metrics, and RUNE price.

tools.name: get_mimir
tools.description: Returns THORChain protocol configuration parameters (Mimir values). These are key-value pairs that control protocol behavior like fees, limits, and feature flags.

tools.name: get_mimir_admin
tools.description: Returns the admin mimir configuration. These are protocol parameters set directly by THORChain admins (the dev team) rather than through node voting. Admin overrides take precedence over node votes.

tools.name: get_mimir_key
tools.description: Returns the effective value for a specific mimir key. This shows the final resolved value after considering admin overrides and node voting consensus. Use this to check the current value of any individual protocol parameter.

tools.name: get_mimir_node
tools.description: Returns the mimir settings voted by a specific node. Shows a map of mimir keys to their voted values for the given node address. Use this to see what protocol parameters a specific node operator is voting for.

tools.name: get_network_info
tools.description: Returns THORChain network statistics and health information including bond metrics, pool data, and node counts.

tools.name: get_network_summary
tools.description: Compact THORChain network status for agents: node counts, bonding/liquidity APY, reserve, pooled RUNE, next churn height, vault migration flag. Prefer this over get_network_info, which returns large per-node bond arrays.

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Returns detailed information for a specific validator node including bond, status, version, and performance metrics. Bond providers include their Bond Yield configuration (bps share of rewards paid out automatically and its payout_target) when one is set.

tools.name: get_oracle_price
tools.description: Returns the oracle price for a specific asset symbol. The price is returned in USD and is used for protocol calculations and limit order pricing.

tools.name: get_oracle_prices
tools.description: Returns all oracle prices for supported assets. Oracle prices are used for determining asset values in the protocol and for pricing limit orders. Returns an array of price objects containing symbol (e.g., BTC, ETH) and price in USD.

tools.name: get_outbound_fee_asset
tools.description: Returns outbound fee information for a specific asset including the fee amount, surplus/deficit tracking, and dynamic multiplier.

tools.name: get_outbound_fees
tools.description: Returns outbound fee information for all assets including the fee amount, surplus/deficit tracking, and dynamic multiplier. Use this to estimate transaction costs.

tools.name: get_outbound_queue
tools.description: Returns the outbound queue containing signed transactions waiting to be broadcast to external chains. Each entry includes the destination chain, address, coin amount, and gas information. These transactions have been signed and are awaiting confirmation.

tools.name: get_pool
tools.description: Returns detailed information for a specific liquidity pool by asset identifier.

tools.name: get_pool_slip
tools.description: Returns slip data for one pool, including current slip and rollup statistics.

tools.name: get_pool_stats
tools.description: Returns detailed analytics and statistics for a specific liquidity pool including volume, fees, APY, and historical metrics.

tools.name: get_queue
tools.description: Returns queue statistics including pending swap count, outbound transaction count, internal queue size, and scheduled outbound value. Use this to understand network congestion.

tools.name: get_ragnarok
tools.description: Returns whether the chain is in Ragnarok (emergency shutdown mode). Ragnarok is triggered when the network needs to return all funds to users. A true value indicates the network is shutting down.

tools.name: get_reference_memo
tools.description: Returns the memoless transaction memo for a given asset and reference number. Memoless transactions use the amount to encode the reference which maps to a pre-registered memo.

tools.name: get_reference_memo_by_hash
tools.description: Returns the memoless transaction memo for a given reference hash. Use this to look up the registered memo for a memoless transaction.

tools.name: get_rune_history
tools.description: Returns historical RUNE data including price over time intervals.

tools.name: get_rune_pool
tools.description: Returns the RUNEPool state: protocol-owned liquidity, provider shares, reserve position, deposit limits, and pending deposits/withdrawals.

tools.name: get_rune_price_history
tools.description: Returns historical RUNE price data in USD over time intervals.

tools.name: get_rune_provider
tools.description: Returns one RUNEPool provider's position: deposited RUNE, units, and PnL.

tools.name: get_runepool_member
tools.description: Returns Midgard's analytics view of a RUNEPool member: deposit/withdraw history and current units.

tools.name: get_scheduled_queue
tools.description: Returns the scheduled outbound queue containing transactions waiting to be signed and broadcast. Each entry includes the destination chain, address, coin amount, gas rate, and associated memo. Transactions are scheduled based on outbound delay.

tools.name: get_stable_reserve
tools.description: Returns the Stable Reserve module status: RUNE balance, depeg tolerance, POL share, per-asset inventory with health flags and oracle prices, and active deployment swaps. Requires THORNode v3.20+; earlier networks answer 501 Not Implemented.

tools.name: get_stable_reserve_contributor
tools.description: Returns a contributor's Stable Reserve credit for a given stable asset and address. Requires THORNode v3.20+; earlier networks answer 501 Not Implemented.

tools.name: get_streaming_swap
tools.description: Returns details of a specific streaming swap by transaction hash, including progress (count/quantity), amounts swapped (in/out), and any failed sub-swaps.

tools.name: get_swap_details
tools.description: Returns detailed information about a specific swap including its current state. Shows the full swap message with source/target assets, amounts, destination, affiliate info, and the swap's status and queue type. Use this to track the progress of a specific swap transaction.

tools.name: get_swap_history
tools.description: Returns historical swap data including swap counts, volumes, fees, and average slip over time intervals.

tools.name: get_swap_queue
tools.description: Returns the current swap queue containing pending swaps waiting to be executed. Each entry includes source/target assets, amounts, destination addresses, and swap state. Use this to monitor swap processing and identify stuck transactions.

tools.name: get_swapper_clout
tools.description: Returns an address's swapper clout: accumulated fee-based score that reduces outbound delays for trusted swappers.

tools.name: get_tcy_claimer
tools.description: Returns TCY (ThorCoin Yeet) claimer information for a specific address. Takes the claimer's L1 address (e.g. 0x..., bc1..., ltc1...) as listed by list_tcy_claimers and returns the claims (one per asset). Use this to check an individual's TCY claims.

tools.name: get_tcy_distribution
tools.description: Returns TCY distribution for an address.

tools.name: get_tcy_staker
tools.description: Returns TCY (ThorCoin Yeet) staker information for a specific address. Shows the staked amount for the given THORChain address. Use this to check an individual's TCY staking position.

tools.name: get_thorname
tools.description: Returns THORName registration information including owner, expiry, and registered chain addresses. THORNames are human-readable aliases for blockchain addresses.

tools.name: get_thorname_owner
tools.description: Returns THORNames owned by an address.

tools.name: get_trade_account
tools.description: Returns all trade account positions for a specific address. Each account includes the asset, units, owner, and last activity heights.

tools.name: get_trade_unit
tools.description: Returns trade unit information for a specific asset. Trade units represent the total units and depth of a trade asset pool.

tools.name: get_tss_metrics
tools.description: Returns TSS keygen and keysign timing metrics across the validator set.

tools.name: get_tvl_history
tools.description: Returns historical Total Value Locked (TVL) data including pooled value, bonded value, and total locked value over time intervals.

tools.name: get_tx
tools.description: Returns transaction details for a given hash including observed transaction data, status, and processing stages.

tools.name: get_tx_details
tools.description: Returns comprehensive transaction details including observed transactions, actions taken, outbound transactions, consensus and finalized heights, and whether the vault was updated or the transaction reverted. Use this for deep transaction analysis.

tools.name: get_tx_stages
tools.description: Returns detailed processing stages of an inbound transaction including observation counts, confirmation status, swap status (with streaming progress if applicable), outbound delay, and signing status.

tools.name: get_tx_status
tools.description: Returns comprehensive transaction status including processing stages, planned outbound transactions, and completed outbound transactions. Use this to track swap progress.

tools.name: get_upgrade_proposal
tools.description: Returns a specific upgrade proposal by name including target block height and upgrade information.

tools.name: get_upgrade_votes
tools.description: Returns all node votes for a specific upgrade proposal. Each vote shows the node address and whether they approved. Use this to track upgrade consensus.

tools.name: get_vault
tools.description: Returns a specific vault by its public key including coin balances, status, membership, routers, and chain addresses.

tools.name: get_vault_pubkeys
tools.description: Returns all vault public keys organized by type: Asgard (active network vaults), Yggdrasil (node vaults), and inactive vaults. Includes router addresses and membership information.

tools.name: get_vault_solvency
tools.description: Returns aggregate vault solvency showing over-solvent or under-solvent amounts per asset. Positive amounts indicate over-solvency (more assets than expected), negative amounts indicate under-solvency. Critical for monitoring vault health.

tools.name: get_version
tools.description: Returns network version information including current version, next required version for nodes, and the querier version.

tools.name: get_votes
tools.description: Returns governance votes including parameter proposals and node votes.

tools.name: list_asgard_vaults
tools.description: Returns current Asgard vaults with their pubkeys, coin balances, status, membership, and chain addresses. Asgard vaults are the main network vaults that hold user funds. Supports pagination with limit and offset parameters.

tools.name: list_derived_pools
tools.description: Lists all derived (virtual) pools with their depths and status.

tools.name: list_invariants
tools.description: Returns the list of available protocol invariants that can be checked. Invariants are consistency checks that verify the protocol's internal state is valid. Common invariants include 'asgard', 'bond', 'pools', 'thorchain', etc.

tools.name: list_liquidity_providers
tools.description: Returns all liquidity providers for a specific pool. Each entry includes the LP's units, pending amounts, deposit values, and addresses. Use this to analyze pool participation.

tools.name: list_mimir_node_votes
tools.description: Returns all node operator votes on mimir settings. Each vote shows the mimir key, the voted value, and the node address that cast the vote. Use this to track node consensus on protocol parameter changes.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: Returns all registered validator nodes with their status, bond amounts, and operational information. Each bond provider may carry a Bond Yield configuration (bps share of rewards paid out automatically and its payout_target); the fields are absent on nodes without one. Supports pagination with limit

tools.name: list_pool_slips
tools.description: Returns pool slip information for all Layer 1 pools. Pool slip measures trading activity and depth pressure. Shows current slip, rollup counts, and long-term rollup medians used for fee calculations and pool health monitoring.

tools.name: list_pools
tools.description: Returns all active liquidity pools on THORChain with their balances, units, and status. Supports pagination with limit and offset parameters.

tools.name: list_rune_providers
tools.description: Lists all RUNEPool providers with their deposited RUNE and units.

tools.name: list_streaming_swaps
tools.description: Returns all active streaming swaps. Streaming swaps split large trades into smaller chunks executed over multiple blocks to minimize slippage. Supports pagination with limit and offset parameters.

tools.name: list_tcy_claimers
tools.description: Returns all TCY (ThorCoin Yeet) claimers. Shows summary information for all addresses that have claimed in the TCY program.

tools.name: list_tcy_stakers
tools.description: Returns all TCY (ThorCoin Yeet) stakers. Shows summary information for all addresses that have staked in the TCY program.

tools.name: list_trade_accounts
tools.description: Returns all trade accounts for a specific trade asset. Each account includes the asset, units, owner address, and activity history.

tools.name: list_trade_units
tools.description: Returns all trade units across all trade assets. Each unit includes the asset, total units, and depth.

tools.name: list_upgrade_proposals
tools.description: Returns all pending network upgrade proposals. Each proposal includes the upgrade name, target block height, and upgrade info. Use this to monitor upcoming network changes.

tools.name: lookup_thorname
tools.description: Returns THORName details including chain addresses, expiry, and owner.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Health check endpoint. Returns 'pong' if the THORNode is responding. Use this to verify connectivity to the node.

tools.name: prepare_swap
tools.description: Build a ready-to-execute THORChain swap. Returns the exact vault address to send to, the memo, the source chain, the expected output and guaranteed minimum, the estimated time, and an expiry. Use this when the user wants to actually perform a swap, not just price it (for pricing only, use quote_swap

tools.name: quote_limit
tools.description: Get a limit order quote with expected output, expiry time, and a generated memo for executing the limit order. Limit orders execute when the target price is reached.

tools.name: quote_swap
tools.description: Calculate how much output you would receive when swapping one asset for another. Use this tool to answer questions like 'how much ETH would I get for 100 RUNE?' Returns expected output amount, fees, slippage, estimated time, and a memo for executing the swap.

tools.name: reverse_lookup_thorname
tools.description: Returns THORNames associated with an address.

tools.name: search_cometbft_tx
tools.description: Searches for transactions matching the query. Supports queries like 'tx.height=1000', 'message.action="send"', or composite queries. Returns matching transactions with optional proofs.

tools.name: search_cosmos_txs
tools.description: Searches for transactions matching the query events. Supports filtering by message type, sender, recipient, and other event attributes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_cometbft_consensus_state, get_invariant, get_swap_details, search_cometbft_tx, search_cosmos_txs · Private data: get_cosmos_supply, get_cosmos_validators, get_inbound_addresses, get_keygen, get_keygen_metric, get_keysign_pubkey, get_network_summary, get_tx_details, get_vault, get_vault_pubkeys, get_vault_solvency, prepare_swap · Public sink: get_node, get_outbound_queue, get_scheduled_queue, get_stable_reserve, list_nodes, prepare_swap, search_cometbft_tx · Destructive: get_ban, prepare_swap, quote_limit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_cometbft_consensus_state, get_invariant, get_swap_details, search_cometbft_tx, search_cosmos_txs · Private data: get_cosmos_supply, get_cosmos_validators, get_inbound_addresses, get_keygen, get_keygen_metric, get_keysign_pubkey, get_network_summary, get_tx_details, get_vault, get_vault_pubkeys, get_vault_solvency, prepare_swap · Public sink: get_node, get_outbound_queue, get_scheduled_queue, get_stable_reserve, list_nodes, prepare_swap, search_cometbft_tx · Destructive: get_ban, prepare_swap, quote_limit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_swap_quote" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_pools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List THORChain liquidity pools with status, depths (1e8 base units), and USD asset price. Filter by pool status or by chain/asset to avoid pulling the full list." → after: "Returns all active liquidity pools on THORChain with their balances, units, and status. Supports pagination with limit and offset parameters."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.detail: Tool "get_network_status" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
